title: Benoit Cottage
meta_description: Elegant Rosemary Beach home sleeps 12 with 4 bedrooms, 4 baths, loft & porches. Gourmet kitchen, steps from beach, pools & dining.
description_expanded: DescriptionIdyllic Rosemary Beach is filled to the brim with gorgeous architecture and luxurious yet charming private homes. Yet even in this picture-perfect beachfront community, Benoit Cottage seems to stand in a class all its own. With four bedrooms spread out over three elegant levels, Benoit Cottage boasts a stunning, artistic style and a premier location. Guests will enjoy access to all that Rosemary Beach has to offer— including effortless access to the sugary white beach, four glittering pools, eight tennis courts, and a bustling town center— while maintaining a feeling of privacy and seclusion.The beauty of Benoit Cottage begins in the soaring great room. The multistory vaulted ceiling is finished with natural cypress and highlights the floor-to-ceiling windows and tiled fireplace perfectly. A cream-colored sofa and neutral armchairs surround the unique carved wood coffee table and provide plenty of comfy space for everyone to relax and socialize. Glass doors lead outside to the sunny terrace.A striking, curved tile wall leads into the sleek and modern kitchen. Dark cabinets and a glossy lime green storage area surround the suite of stainless steel appliances— including a SubZero refrigerator, double Wolf ovens, and a gas range. There’s seating for eight at the dining table, as well as three bar stools at the glass bar on the island.A custom iron railing leads you downstairs to where three peaceful and private sleeping spaces await. The first is the primary bedroom suite— located at the end of the hallway and complete with a sumptuous king-size bed and attached bathroom with a step-in shower. The second bedroom on this level is a bunk room with two built-in twin-over-twin bunk beds, while a third bedroom features a queen-size, four-poster bed. An additional full bathroom with a tub/shower combo can be accessed from the hallway. There is also a laundry nook on this floor with a high-efficiency washer and dryer.If you follow the stairs up to the top floor, you’ll find a lofted sleeping space with a king-size bed. This flexible area also includes a cozy living room with a queen-size sleeper sofa, large HDTV, and built-in bookshelves. The ensuite bathroom in the loft has a walk-in, glass-enclosed shower. This comfortable loft hideaway is concealed from the lower floor by a pair of heavy drapes.Benoit Cottage has three sun-kissed porches— one on the lower level and two on the main level— to soak up the bright Rosemary Beach sunshine. When you’re ready to explore this endlessly delightful community, there are so many things to do. Take a dip in one of four community swimming pools, stroll through the cobblestone streets and beautiful parks, spend the day with your toes in the sand at the beach, enjoy a romantic dinner for two at one of many mouth-watering restaurants, or simply kick back with a cold drink on your private terrace and relax.There’s also a courtyard with a gas grill that Benoit Cottage shares with the neighboring Benoit Carriage House. Larger parties may want to consider renting both the cottage and carriage house for maximum privacy.PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:* Professionally designed* 1 Minute walk to the beach* 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes* Clean Bedding ProgramHOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 12)FIRST FLOOR* PRIMARY SUITE with a king-size bed and ensuite BATH (Sleeps 2)* BUNK ROOM with two twin-over-twin bunk beds (Sleeps 4)* BEDROOM with a queen-size bed (Sleeps 2)* FULL BATHROOM* LAUNDRY AREA* Large, wrap-around DECK* Shared COURTYARD with gas grillMAIN FLOOR* Open LIVING AREA with HDTV and fireplace* Gourmet KITCHEN and DINING AREA* Two BALCONIES* Half BATHROOMSECOND FLOOR* Lofted SLEEPING SPACE with a king-size bed and queen sleeper sofa (Sleeps 4)* Ensuite BATHROOM
